steps.goal: Transcribe the .mp4 file so we can check it against the published script.

steps.label: Script compliance Report
steps.goal: Check the dialogue from the video to see if it matches order and content of the existing script.   create a manifest of changes.

steps.label: Set Movie for Alchemy Review
steps.goal: Check to ensure the .mp4 exists in the render files and set it for review in alchemy

steps.name: GenerateTranscript
steps.label: Generate Transcript
steps.goal: Gives the user a popup where they can choose the spoken language (English is default) and generates a transcript through AWS followed by an srt transcript for any editorial package. Service: alc.services.ai.transcription.create.subtitles()

steps.name: CreateFolders
steps.label: Create Folders
steps.goal: Create a working folder in compliance with the studio's folder structure.
steps.end_result: Every time someone starts a task, the correct structure is created instantly - consistent and visible to the entire production.
steps.min_scenario: You hand-build the structure to the studio's convention — when the convention is clear and the inputs are present.
steps.max_scenario: The convention is undocumented or inconsistent across artists; you rebuild and reconcile it by hand.

steps.goal:
We're checking for files in the render directory
:return:
steps.min_scenario: You eyeball the asset against the checklist by hand — naming, scale, topology, etc. — when it's clean and there's nothing to fix.
steps.max_scenario: You miss something (or there's a lot to fix); it ships, breaks in a downstream department, and bounces back days later for a re-publish.

steps.name: Publish
steps.label: Publish
steps.min_scenario: You manually copy the version to the publish/latest location and a coordinator hand-updates the tracker and pings downstream — when everyone actually does their part.
steps.max_scenario: The coordinator's slammed and forgets (or no one notifies downstream); everyone waiting burns days on Slack, text, email, phone, and walking the building to find out if it's ready.

steps.name: SetStatus
steps.label: Set Status
steps.goal: Set Status of the current task (if not handled in publish) and set downstream statuses to "Ready to Start"
steps.min_scenario: You do the cleanup by hand before handing off — quick when you remember it.
steps.max_scenario: You forget or do it wrong; the mistake ships in the file and gets flagged downstream, forcing a redo.
